row:
Originally from Colorado, Charles L. Starr III is a veterinarian. In his practice, Charles L. Starr III specializes in treating domestic pets, farm animals, and rescued wildlife. He staffs a full service veterinary clinic that offers grooming, boarding, and has an animal behavior specialist on call. Charles L. Starr III runs the clinic with the assistance of his daughter and office manager, Erin. 

Having grown up in rural Wisconsin, Charles L. Starr III was exposed to the unique relationships that people have with their animals at a very early age. His father owned and operated a small family farm where Charles L. Starr III and his siblings worked milking cows, brushing horses, and collecting eggs. He learned to respect the animals and value each for their role in his family's livelihood.
